exec: // Verify group creation and save its ID and invite code for later requests.
pm.test('group owner matches the authenticated owner', () => pm.expect(body.group.owner_id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('ownerId')));
// Later requests join this group and create or query its quizzes.

request.description: Create a group using the owner token inherited from the collection. Expect HTTP 201 and the registered owner ID; save the group ID and invite code for subsequent membership and quiz requests.
